headline: Approved board reappointments and golf club rate schedule, each by a 2-0 vote
summary: The committee approved reappointments of ten members to the Economic and Community Development Council, including James Muse, Diantha Phothisan, Jason Consalvo, Donna Musumeci, Thomas Holland, Christopher Wrenn, Nathan Seavey, Zach Servideo, Dan Allon, and Kevin Grant. It also approved a reappointment for Christopher Tatnall to the same council and approved the Beverly Golf and Tennis Club 2026 Member Rate Schedule.
decisions: Approved reappointments of James Muse, Diantha Phothisan, Jason Consalvo, Donna Musumeci, Thomas Holland, Christopher Wrenn, Nathan Seavey, Zach Servideo, Dan Allon and Kevin Grant to the Economic and Community Development Council, 2-0 (Order #094).
Approved reappointment of Christopher Tatnall, 91R Hale Street, to the Economic and Community Development Council, 2-0 (Order #096).
Approved the Beverly Golf and Tennis Club 2026 Member Rate Schedule, 2-0 (Order #097).
